method.trend: Completed H4 close below EMA20 below EMA50, EMA20 falling versus 3 bars ago = short; inverse = long; otherwise neutral. Warmup from Aug 1.
method.entry: Counterfactual at first full M1 bid/ask open following actual fill; no invented spread.
method.stops: Original stored stop distance or preceding 6 completed H4 bid lows/ask highs plus 1 pip buffer. Structural units resized to same stored dollar risk. WiderStructuralStop arms use the larger of stored stop distance and the structural distance, resizing units to preserve dollar risk. StructuralStop arms allow narrower stops and larger units.
method.exit: 2R target or 48 wall-clock hours; stop-first if both touched within M1; gaps filled at worse opening price.
method.costs: Historical bid/ask included. Actual financing verified from broker. Hypothetical financing estimated from observed same-date rates where available, otherwise current instrument rates, with rollover weekday schedule and 1% conversion adjustment. Historical daily rates incomplete. Commission metadata absent; no additional execution slippage modeled.
method.limits: Stored stops may have been edited; same-exit candles approximate exit by completed M1 close. Overlapping trade opportunities assumed retained; not independent observations.

holdingExposure.exactHistoricalMarginFeasibility: Not established; need historical balance, other exposure and instrument-specific historical margin.

isolatedEURUSDAccount.conclusion: EUR-only replay appears supportable at 2% margin. Actual other-pair exposure and intraminute equity remain unmodeled; this is not proof for the whole account.
